Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION NO. HON. RICHARD B. STREEGAN Municipal Mayor Office of the Municipal Mayor Sogod, Cebu Dear Mayor Streegan: 14 OCT 2019 This is in reference to your letter dated 18 June 2019 which was indorsed to this Office by DILG Region VII on 15 July 2019 requesting for an opinion on what action can be taken in connection with the four (4) consecutive absences in the Sanggunian Bayan (SB) sessions of SK Federation President Michael Arden A. Monisit, Ex-Officio Member of the SB of Sogod, Cebu for the month of March 2019. Foremost, since the official concerned is an ex-officio member of the SB of However, in such application of the IRP in this case, please be guided by Section 50 of RA 7160 otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) which provides: Section 50. Internal Rules of Procedure. — Xxx b. The rules for procedure shall provide for the following: (5) The discipline of members for disorderly behavior and absences without justifiable cause for four (4) consecutive sessions, for which they may be censured. reprimanded. pr excluded from the session, suspended for not more than sixty (60) days, or expelled: Provided, That the penalty of suspension Qr expulsion shall require the concurrence of at least two-thirds (2/3) vote of all the sanggunian members: Provided, further, That a member convicted by final judgment to imprisonment of at least one (I) year for any crime involving moral turpitude shall be automatically expelled from the sanggunian; Absences regarding the frequency provided under the Local Government Code is contingent on justifiability to be actionable administratively.

Hence, for being absent for 4 consecutive sessions, Hon. Monisit can be disciplined as provided by the above-cited provision of the LGC and also by the provision of your IRP. Please note, however, that the IRP should not be in conflict with the provisions of the LGC and other relevant laws, otherwise, the LGC or law will prevail. In your letter, you cited the relevant provision of the IRP, viz: "Sannguniang Bayan Internal Rules, Rule III, Section 12, (d) Fourth Consecutive unexcused absence without justifiable cause - Exclusion of the erring member from the succeeding sessions and suspension without pay of the absentee- member including all allowances for not more than 30 days or be expelled of which a concurrence of at least 2/3 votes of all members of the Sangguniang Bayan is needed. " May we remind you that based on the LGC, the penalty of suspension should also be with concurrence of the least 2/3 vote of all the sanggunian members. Lastly, since we are talking about imposition of penalty, may we advise you that due process should still be observed before any penalty be imposed. you Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: MARIVEL . SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Undersecretary Copy furnished: DIR. LEOCADIO T. TROVELA Regional Director DILG Region VII Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City LIIS/Lralld/37
